stats.label: Continuos Placement support until successful employment

process.title: Resume Building
process.desc: Our placement team helps craft ATS-friendly resumes that highlight your skills, projects, and certifications effectively.

process.title: Mock Interviews
process.desc: Multiple rounds of mock technical and HR interviews with detailed feedback to build confidence and sharpen responses.

process.title: Aptitude Training
process.desc: Focused aptitude, logical reasoning, and verbal ability sessions to crack the first round at top companies.

process.title: Job Referrals
process.desc: Direct referrals to our network of 100+ hiring partners — IT companies, startups, and MNCs actively hiring from our centre.

successStories.name: Arjun Reddy
successStories.quote: The placement team at Aptech Whitefield was incredible. They helped me crack 3 interviews in 2 weeks. The mock sessions were exactly like the real thing.

successStories.name: Sneha Patel
successStories.quote: I had zero coding background before joining. The structured curriculum and dedicated placement support helped me land a data analyst role at Accenture.

successStories.name: Kiran Kumar
successStories.quote: The AI course was industry-level. Real projects, real tools. My interviewer was impressed by my portfolio. Couldn't have done it without Aptech Whitefield.

successStories.name: Divya Menon
successStories.quote: Cybersecurity was a niche choice but Aptech's network opened doors I didn't expect. Got placed within 6 weeks of completing the course.

successStories.name: Rahul Singh
successStories.quote: The AWS certification prep was thorough. Passed on first attempt and got placed at Capgemini. The ROI on this course was amazing.

successStories.name: Priya Nair
successStories.quote: Got placed at a fast-growing Bangalore startup as a digital marketing executive. The practical campaigns we ran during training were my biggest interview talking points.
